lead: Kalki Koechlin is a French stage actor, born on 10 January 1984 in Pondicherry.
As of 2026, she is 42 years old, and her birth date places her under the Capricorn sign.

She is associated with work such as Made in Heaven, Gully Boy and Margarita, with a Straw and has been recognised with National Film Award – Special Jury Award / Special Mention and Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actress.
